definition.title: Cancelled predecessor fee exemption and identical reactivation
definition.expectedInvariant: An actually Cancelled same-slot entry may be replaced below the live fee bump or resubmitted identically after affordability is restored; live guards apply again.
preconditions: Owned isolated mining fixture with manual sidecar bundling
Real cancellation after mined payer drain, no status injection
Verified 300-second TTL; both reacceptances occur before expiry

limitations: Fresh staged-fork mining fixture; manual sidecar bundling and ordinary canonical transfers.
Seed identifies action order, not private signing keys; fresh accounts are random.
Cancelled predecessor only; no OnChain/Finalized/Reverted, exact TTL-boundary or Submitted/Pending claims.
